alt: A Black protester with an afro kneels on one knee against a plain pale-gray background, one gloved fist raised straight overhead. They wear a teal long-sleeved top, black pants, a surgical mask, and a pale backpack, and hold a blank white protest sign at their side.

Large teal safety goggles with a gray strap sit above a pair of gray-framed eyeglasses marked with a teal check, and an eye being touched by a fingertip inserting a contact lens, crossed out with a pink X. The heading reads "DO wear goggles if you have access to them. DO wear glasses (under goggles) if needed. DON'T wear contacts — they trap tear gas."
text:
DO WEAR GOGGLES IF YOU HAVE ACCESS TO THEM.
DO WEAR GLASSES (UNDER GOGGLES) IF NEEDED.
DON'T WEAR CONTACTS — THEY TRAP TEAR GAS.

alt: Four face coverings in a row — a knotted teal bandana, a light blue surgical mask, a patterned teal cloth mask, and a teal half-face respirator — above two gray silhouetted protesters holding signs overhead with a wide teal double-headed arrow between them. The heading reads "DO wear a mask covering your nose & mouth to protect against tear gas and coronavirus. DO bring extra masks for others. DO maintain physical distancing if possible."
text:
DO WEAR A MASK COVERING YOUR NOSE & MOUTH TO PROTECT AGAINST TEAR GAS AND CORONAVIRUS.
DO BRING EXTRA MASKS FOR OTHERS.
DO MAINTAIN PHYSICAL DISTANCING IF POSSIBLE.

alt: A large plastic bottle is bracketed into two labeled sections, "WATER" on the top half and "POWERADE" on the bottom. To the right, a pink X crosses out a coffee cup, a wine glass, and a soda can, while a teal check mark sits beside a teal wrapper labeled "PROTEIN." The heading reads "DO hydrate with water & electrolyte drinks. DON'T consume caffeine, soda or alcohol — these can be dehydrating. DO bring snacks for yourself and others."
text:
DO HYDRATE WITH WATER & ELECTROLYTE DRINKS.
DON'T CONSUME CAFFEINE, SODA OR ALCOHOL — THESE CAN BE DEHYDRATING.
DO BRING SNACKS FOR YOURSELF AND OTHERS.
WATER
POWERADE
PROTEIN

alt: A masked person with an afro wipes their forehead under a beating sun drawn with radiating lines, next to a black long-sleeved shirt and pants laid out flat, and a tube of sunscreen labeled "UVA & UVB" with teal droplets beside it. The heading reads "DO avoid heat stroke by finding shade & water. DO wear sleeves & pants as protection from sunburn and tear gas. DON'T apply oil-based sunscreen as it can increase tear gas irritation."
text:
DO AVOID HEAT STROKE BY FINDING SHADE & WATER.
DO WEAR SLEEVES & PANTS AS PROTECTION FROM SUNBURN AND TEAR GAS.
DON'T APPLY OIL-BASED SUNSCREEN AS IT CAN INCREASE TEAR GAS IRRITATION.
UVA & UVB

alt: A gray hand reaches toward a smoking canister labeled "RIOT CONTROL" and is crossed out with a large pink X. To the right, a teal speech bubble shouting "GAS!" and an ear with an earplug each get a teal check mark. The heading reads "DON'T touch tear gas cans — they burn. DO warn everyone to get out of range of gas. DO wear earplugs to muffle loud bangs."
text:
DON'T TOUCH TEAR GAS CANS — THEY BURN.
DO WARN EVERYONE TO GET OUT OF RANGE OF GAS.
DO WEAR EARPLUGS TO MUFFLE LOUD BANGS.
RIOT CONTROL
GAS!

alt: A teal smartphone with a padlock at its corner displays a keypad screen reading "ENTER PASSCODE" with six empty dots. Beside it are a teal messaging-app icon with a dashed speech bubble and a gray cloud with a teal arrow pointing up into it. The heading reads "DO ensure your phone unlocks with a typed password only — no touch or face ID. DO communicate through a secure app such as Signal. DO back up your phone to the cloud."
text:
DO ENSURE YOUR PHONE UNLOCKS WITH A TYPED PASSWORD ONLY — NO TOUCH OR FACE ID.
DO COMMUNICATE THROUGH A SECURE APP SUCH AS SIGNAL.
DO BACK UP YOUR PHONE TO THE CLOUD.
ENTER PASSCODE

alt: A person in black with goggles and a mask stands with both arms raised and wrists crossed above their head, shouting "MEDIC!" in a speech bubble. To the right, a teal check mark sits beside an eye with teal droplets falling from it, and another check mark beside a bottle labeled "Maalox." The heading reads "DO cross hands over head to call for a medic if you or someone else is injured. DO use water on eyes for gas & pepper spray. DO use Maalox on skin for gas & pepper spray."
text:
DO CROSS HANDS OVER HEAD TO CALL FOR A MEDIC IF YOU OR SOMEONE ELSE IS INJURED.
DO USE WATER ON EYES FOR GAS & PEPPER SPRAY.
DO USE MAALOX ON SKIN FOR GAS & PEPPER SPRAY.
MEDIC!
Maalox

alt: A worried woman in a pink shirt gestures while talking to a stern gray-uniformed police officer with folded arms, the pair marked with a pink X. Below, a teal check mark accompanies a forearm with "(415) 285-5067" written on the skin and an arrow captioned "find the # of your local National Lawyer's Guild in case of arrest," while a pink X crosses out a passport and a jeweled bracelet. The heading reads "DON'T talk to police without a lawyer if you are detained. DO write the National Lawyers Guild phone number on your body beforehand. DON'T bring valuable or irreplaceable items."
text:
DON'T TALK TO POLICE WITHOUT A LAWYER IF YOU ARE DETAINED.
DO WRITE THE NATIONAL LAWYERS GUILD PHONE NUMBER ON YOUR BODY BEFOREHAND.
DON'T BRING VALUABLE OR IRREPLACEABLE ITEMS.
(415) 285-5067
FIND THE # OF YOUR LOCAL NATIONAL LAWYER'S GUILD IN CASE OF ARREST.
PASSPORT

The lettering above reads "REMEMBER: STAY ALERT. FOLLOW THE LEADERSHIP OF ACTIVISTS OF COLOR." with "FIGHT ON!" in teal below it.
text:
REMEMBER: STAY ALERT.
FOLLOW THE LEADERSHIP OF ACTIVISTS OF COLOR.
